subject: english

sections.title: Grammar
sections.instruction: For each question, choose the word or phrase that best completes the sentence.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.instruction: For each question, choose the word or phrase closest in meaning to the underlined word, or that best fits the sentence.

sections.title: Vocabulary Cloze
sections.instruction: Read the passage. For each numbered blank, choose the word that best fits.
sections.note: Thin supply (11 sets in the data): a child will meet repeats sooner. Draw it, but fall back to any set already seen.

sections.title: Visual Text Comprehension
sections.instruction: Study the notice, poster or message, then answer the questions.

sections.title: Grammar Cloze
sections.instruction: Fill in every blank in the passage with one word. Write each answer in its box.

sections.title: Editing for Spelling and Grammar
sections.instruction: Find the mistakes in the passage and write the correction for each.
sections.reason: No Editing questions are in the bank yet; the section is open-answer and waits for the Editing pipeline.

sections.title: Comprehension Cloze
sections.instruction: Fill in every blank in the passage with one word. Write each answer in its box.

sections.title: Synthesis and Transformation
sections.instruction: Rewrite each sentence as instructed. Keep the meaning the same.
sections.note: Typed whole-sentence answers; marks per question 2 (all or nothing in the first build; partial marks are a later question).

sections.title: Comprehension (Open-ended)
sections.instruction: Read the passage and answer each question in complete sentences.
sections.reason: Open-ended answers need a marker (a teacher or a checked model); the site cannot mark them yet.
